messages:
fern: Quick keyboard/a11y issue spotted on the Bulk Actions toolbar. When selecting rows and toggling the "Select all" checkbox, focus jumps unpredictably and screen readers don't hear the selection count change.
raj: Repro?
fern: Steps: tab to first row -> Shift+Down to multiselect -> Press header "Select all" -> focus moves to action menu instead of staying on header checkbox; NVDA reads nothing about "3 selected".
zoe: Sounds like missing aria-live for selection count and broken focus restore. The header checkbox should be a real input with aria-checked and when count changes we should announce it.
drew: Agree. Also the action menu seems to steal focus on update. Maybe we re-render the menu which traps focus. We should ensure updates don't re-mount the action button.
fern: Proposed: (1) Keep header checkbox as <input type="checkbox" aria-label="Select all rows" aria-checked="false"> and update aria-checked properly. (2) Add a single role="status" aria-live="polite" node for selection count updates and set text "3 rows selected" debounced. (3) Ensure action menu is a stable DOM node; update children only so focus isn't lost.
raj: Good. Any code snippet?
zoe: small helper:
function announceSelection(n) {
  const el = document.getElementById('a11y-row-selection');
  if (!el) return;
  el.textContent = `${n} rows selected`;
}
Also set aria-checked on header checkbox and use roving tabindex for row checkboxes.
drew: Nice. Also color nit: selection bar background on focus has poor contrast in dark theme (1.9:1). Auto-scan image: https://attachments/reports/bulk-select-contrast.png
a11y_bot: Scan: selection count not announced, header checkbox missing explicit aria-checked in some browsers, focus loss due to re-render of action menu, focus ring contrast low (dark theme 1.9:1). Recommend fixes above and adding keyboard + screen reader e2e.
fern: I'll open a PR with aria-live node, aria-checked updates, avoid remounting menu, and adjust focus ring to use var(--focus-strong) for dark theme. Assigning @raj for review.
raj: Thanks. For debounce: 300ms should be ok, and clear after 1s. Also add unit tests asserting aria-checked and announcer text mutation.
zoe: Add e2e: tab to list, multiselect via shift+down, press header checkbox, expect announcer text and focus still on header checkbox.
drew: Also ensure pressing Escape closes action menu and returns focus.
a11y_bot: CI reminder: include NVDA + VoiceOver smoke runs for keyboard flows.
fern: Marking resolved when PR merges. :white_check_mark:
